recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is recommended for FHIR-46364 unless a later work-group decision changes how _summary should treat Extension content.
issue_request: FHIR-46364 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to mark Extension url and value as isSummary=true and to clarify ElementDefinition.isSummary comments so summary status is promoted only from descendants within the same StructureDefinition.
initial_application: Git commit 82e672f8c142fbb73bbb57cef4267b2731354939 already applied the issue by updating source/datatypes/extension.xml and source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml. Its parent had blank Summary cells for Extension.@url and Extension.value[x], while current source has y for both and includes the requested same-StructureDefinition clarification.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Extension and ElementDefinition in active core datatype/type-page build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-07-29 reference FHIR-46364, record the 7-0-0 vote, and state that the clarification is in the ElementDefinition comment rather than conformance language on the page. Quoted Zulip and Confluence FTS searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has y in the Summary column for Extension.@url and Extension.value[x], and ElementDefinition.isSummary comments already contain the 'within the same StructureDefinition' clarification requested by the Jira resolution.
